label: Outside
title: Nature, first
text: I'm a nature lover, and I like plants. Away from a desk, outside is where I'd rather be.

label: The levee
title: Bike rides on the levee
text: Some days I ride my bike along the levee by the river. It's the best way I know to clear my head.

label: Tyga
title: My cat, Tyga
text: Tyga is my cat, and I love that cat.
